stories.headline: Iran goes 'fully offensive' and keeps Hormuz shut; Brent tops $91 as US reserve hits 1982 low

key_facts.fact: A senior Iranian official told Reuters on Monday, Aug. 17, that Iran will shift from a defensive to a 'fully offensive' military posture after talks on a permanent end to the war with the US stalled.
key_facts.excerpt: A senior Iranian official separately told Reuters that Tehran could intensify tensions in and beyond the Strait of Hormuz and launch an attack if the United States failed to implement an interim peace agreement fully within weeks.

key_facts.fact: Top Iranian negotiator Mohammad Baqer Qalibaf said on Tuesday, Aug. 18, that Iran will keep the Strait of Hormuz closed until the US meets the conditions of the interim deal signed in June, which Trump has called 'over'.
key_facts.excerpt: Iran will keep the Strait of Hormuz closed until the U.S. meets the conditions of the interim deal signed in June, top Iranian negotiator Mohammad Baqer Qalibaf said in comments published by state media on Tuesday.

key_facts.fact: Brent crude settled up $2.35, or 2.65%, at $90.87 a barrel on Monday, Aug. 17, and traded around $91.07 on Tuesday, its highest since July 30; WTI settled at $84.50 on Monday, up 2.55%.
key_facts.excerpt: Brent crude futures rose US$2.35, or 2.65%, to settle at US$90.87 a barrel. US West Texas Intermediate crude gained US$2.10, or 2.55%, to US$84.50 a barrel.

key_facts.fact: Kpler ship-tracking data showed five commodity vessels crossed the Strait of Hormuz on Saturday and none on Sunday, versus 31 the prior weekend; about 130 vessels a day crossed before the war began on Feb. 28.
key_facts.excerpt: Five commodity vessels transited the strait on Saturday, with none registered for Sunday, shiptracking data from Kpler showed, versus 31 in the prior weekend.

key_facts.fact: US crude in the Strategic Petroleum Reserve fell about 5.3 million barrels in the prior week to 293.4 million barrels, the lowest since December 1982, part of a planned 172-million-barrel coordinated emergency release.
key_facts.excerpt: Remaining reserve: 293.4 million barrels; Weekly reduction: approximately 5.3 million barrels; Reserve level: lowest since December 1982; Planned total release: 172 million barrels

key_facts.fact: JPMorgan estimates each additional month of disruption adds roughly $7-$8 a barrel to Brent, and sees average monthly Brent near $114 if disruption lasts three months; Goldman Sachs warns Brent could reach $120.
key_facts.excerpt: JPMorgan estimated that every additional month of disruption could add around $7 to $8 a barrel to Brent prices. If the disruption lasts for three months, the bank expects average monthly Brent prices to reach around $114 a barrel.

key_facts.fact: Trump said the US would 'bomb the shit' out of Oman if it 'gets in the way' of American efforts on the Strait, and has floated declaring Hormuz US territory.
key_facts.excerpt: "If Oman gets in the way, we'll bomb the shit out of them," Mr Trump told Fox News journalist Trey Yingst, referring to ongoing talks between Oman and Iran on control of the strait.

stories.headline: Netanyahu and Kushner agree a US general will oversee Hamas disarmament before any Israeli pullout

key_facts.fact: Israeli PM Benjamin Netanyahu and US envoy Jared Kushner agreed on Monday, Aug. 17, that an American general would supervise the decommissioning of Hamas's weapons, an Israeli official told AFP.
key_facts.excerpt: "It was also agreed that the first step toward the demilitarisation of the Strip would be to require Hamas to hand over its weapons for decommissioning under the supervision of an American general," the official said.

key_facts.fact: The two sides agreed that no redeployment of Israeli forces and no reconstruction would take place in Gaza before Hamas is disarmed throughout the Strip.
key_facts.excerpt: The two sides "agreed that no redeployment or reconstruction would take place in the Gaza Strip before Hamas is disarmed throughout Gaza", a senior Israeli official told AFP.

key_facts.fact: The understanding is a new attempt by the Trump administration to satisfy Netanyahu, who is facing a tough re-election fight and publicly rejected the latest part of the US plan to end the Gaza war.
key_facts.excerpt: The understanding marks a new attempt by President Donald Trump's administration to satisfy Israel after Netanyahu, facing a tough re-election fight, publicly rejected the latest part of a US plan aimed at ending the devastating Gaza war.

key_facts.fact: A roadmap Hamas accepted on July 30 had said weapons decommissioning would be supervised differently; the Israeli-US understanding places the process under a US general.
key_facts.excerpt: A roadmap agreed by Hamas on July 30 said that the decommissioning of weapons would be supervis

key_facts.fact: Israeli and US officials also agreed that Hamas weapons would be destroyed by the International Stabilization Force, alongside agreed security 'red lines' for Gaza.

stories.headline: European document: Russia is shipping TNT and drone parts to Iran across the Caspian Sea

key_facts.fact: Russia is shipping drone components, ammunition and TNT to Iran through the Caspian Sea, according to a European government document obtained by NBC News and verified by a Western official.
key_facts.excerpt: Russia is shipping drone components, ammunition and TNT to Iran through the Caspian Sea, helping Tehran replenish stockpiles damaged in U.S. and Israeli airstrikes, according to a European government document obtained by NBC News and verified by a Western official.

key_facts.fact: The shipments are helping Tehran replenish missile and drone stockpiles damaged in US and Israeli airstrikes during the war that began on Feb. 28, 2026.

stories.headline: argenx's Vyvgart wins first Phase 3 in autoimmune myositis, a disease subtype with no approved drug

key_facts.fact: argenx announced on Aug. 17 that its ALKIVIA Phase 3 trial of VYVGART Hytrulo (efgartigimod) met its primary endpoint in adults with autoimmune myositis (p=0.0011).
key_facts.excerpt: Study met primary endpoint of mean Total Improvement Score (TIS) at Week 52 in the combined study population of IMNM and DM patients (p=0.0011)

key_facts.fact: In the combined population, efgartigimod delivered a 15.4-point greater improvement in mean Total Improvement Score at Week 52 versus placebo (47.95 vs 32.56).
key_facts.excerpt: patients treated with efgartigimod demonstrated statistically significant and clinically meaningful 15.4-point greater improvement in mean Total Improvement Score (TIS) at Week 52 versus placebo (47.95 vs 32.56).

key_facts.fact: It is the first Phase 3 study to show statistically significant improvement in immune-mediated necrotizing myopathy (IMNM), a subtype with no approved therapy; the IMNM subgroup improved 14.8 points over placebo (p=0.0048).
key_facts.excerpt: First Phase 3 study to show statistically significant and clinically meaningful improvements in disease activity in IMNM, a subtype with no approved therapy

key_facts.fact: In the smaller dermatomyositis cohort the improvement was 14.5 points (51.51 vs 36.96) but did not reach statistical significance (p=0.1093).
key_facts.excerpt: In DM, a similar clinically meaningful improvement of 14.5 points (p=0.1093) was observed (51.51 vs 36.96), though statistical significance was not reached in this smaller cohort.

key_facts.fact: argenx said it will take the data to the FDA; separation from placebo began at Week 4 and held through a full year even with steroid tapering.
key_facts.excerpt: Argenx heads to FDA with Vyvgart after ph. 3 win in potential blockbuster autoimmune indication

stories.headline: NASA flies GPS-free navigation: Starling CubeSats fix their orbit by sighting other satellites

key_facts.fact: NASA announced on Aug. 17, 2026 the successful flight demonstration of FALCON (Fast Autonomous Lost-in-space Catalog-based Optical Navigation) aboard its Starling CubeSat swarm in low Earth orbit.
key_facts.excerpt: On August 17, 2026, NASA announced the successful flight demonstration of the Fast Autonomous Lost-in-space Catalog-based Optical Navigation (FALCON) system aboard the agency's Starling CubeSat mission in low Earth orbit.

key_facts.fact: FALCON determines a spacecraft's orbit by matching objects seen by its star-tracker cameras — other satellites and debris — against a catalog of about 20,000 known space objects loaded onboard, with no ground tracking or GPS.
key_facts.excerpt: The mission team loaded the full catalog of approximately 20,000 space objects and their predicted orbits onto the spacecraft.

key_facts.fact: Over a three-day period FALCON improved the known orbits of more than 200 space objects without any intervention from ground operators.
key_facts.excerpt: During a three-day period, FALCON improved the known orbits of more than 200 objects without intervention from operators on the ground.

key_facts.fact: NASA says the self-orbit determination is a first for spacecraft using optical cameras to navigate relative to other objects in space, and produced better position predictions onboard than ground stations provided.
key_facts.excerpt: The self-orbit determination capability made possible through FALCON is a first for spacecraft using optical cameras to navigate by their relative position to other objects in space.

key_facts.fact: The payload uses commercial partner EraDrive's Era-Core flight software on Starling's 6U CubeSats; later this year the four-spacecraft swarm will share tracking data to refine positions collectively.
key_facts.excerpt: the payload leverages EraDrive's Era-Core flight software integrated into Starling's existing optical star-tracker cameras.

stories.headline: MLB owners approve $3.9B sale of the San Diego Padres, a record for a US baseball franchise

key_facts.fact: MLB owners unanimously approved the purchase of the San Diego Padres on Monday, Aug. 17, by private equity billionaire Jose E. Feliciano and his wife Kwanza Jones, in a deal valuing the team at $3.9 billion.
key_facts.excerpt: MLB owners unanimously approved the purchase of the San Diego Padres Monday to private equity billionaire Jose E. Feliciano and his wife Kwanza Jones. The deal values the team at $3.9 billion and is expected to close in the coming days

key_facts.fact: The price shatters the previous MLB record of $2.42 billion, set when Steve Cohen bought the New York Mets in 2020.
key_facts.excerpt: The price shatters the record for an MLB franchise sale, previously set when Steve Cohen bought the New York Mets for $2.42 billion in 2020.

key_facts.fact: Feliciano will be the control owner and the couple will own a reported 40% of the club; the deal is expected to close within days.
key_facts.excerpt: Feliciano and Jones will own a reported 40% of the club.

key_facts.fact: Three of the bids for the Padres came in at $3.5 billion or more; other finalists included Dan Friedkin, Warriors co-owner Joe Lacob and Pistons owner Tom Gores.
key_facts.excerpt: The Padres had three bids of at least $3.5 billion, including the winning one.

key_facts.fact: The sale process began in November 2025 amid a legal battle among family members of late owner Peter Seidler, who died in 2023, over the trust that held the team.
key_facts.excerpt: The Padres' owners announced the sale process in November, amid a legal battle between family members of late owner Peter Seidler, who died in 2023.

sources.title: San Diego Padres $3.9 Billion Sale Approved by MLB Owners

stories.headline: Madison Air to buy German motor and fan maker ebm-papst for $5.4B

key_facts.fact: Madison Air Solutions (NYSE: MAIR) said on Aug. 17 it signed a definitive agreement to acquire ebm-papst at an enterprise purchase price of $5.4 billion, or $5.0 billion net of future tax savings.
key_facts.excerpt: today announced it has entered into a definitive agreement to acquire ebm-papst at an enterprise purchase price of $5.4 billion, or $5.0 billion net of future tax savings

key_facts.fact: The effective price represents 14.6x ebm-papst's forecast 2026 adjusted EBITDA, or 10x including estimated run-rate synergies.
key_facts.excerpt: The effective enterprise purchase price represents 14.6x ebm-papst's forecasted 2026 adjusted EBITDA, or 10x including estimated run-rate synergies.

key_facts.fact: Madison Air says the deal adds roughly $30 billion to its addressable market and broadens its aftermarket and services opportunities.
key_facts.excerpt: The transaction adds approximately $30 billion to Madison Air's addressable market and broadens its commercial, aftermarket and services opportunities

key_facts.fact: The purchase will be funded with cash on hand plus debt and equity financing, with pro forma net leverage under 4.0x at closing and a target of about 2.5x within two years.
key_facts.excerpt: The Company expects pro forma net leverage of less than 4.0x at closing, with a target of reducing net leverage to approximately 2.5x on a trailing 12-month basis within two years.

key_facts.fact: The transaction is expected to close around year end, subject to regulatory approvals.
key_facts.excerpt: The transaction is expected to close around year end, subject to receipt of required regulatory approvals and satisfaction of customary closing conditions.

sources.title: Madison Air to Acquire ebm-papst, Expanding Return on Air Capabilities and Accelerating Durable Growth in Air Quality Solutions
